blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Motorists are set to get some relief as gasoline prices plunge by P16.80 per liter Tuesday, Nov. 10, marking the first double-digit rollback since the Middle East conflict began in February. Diesel prices will also drop by P4.10 per liter, while kerosene will go down by P3.70 per liter. Based on the Department of Energy’s (DOE) monitoring in Metro Manila from Nov. 3 to 9, gasoline prices ranged from P78.50 to P104.30 per liter, diesel from P88.50 to P101, and kerosene from P115 to P143.94.
